readme:
[Riffle]

A research project aiming to simplify app development by using
 databases for client-side state management.

 By Geoffrey Litt,
 Nicholas Schiefer,
 Johannes Schickling and
 Daniel Jackson at
 the MIT CSAIL Software Design Group.

2024 Dec

The Riffle project has concluded

2023 Oct

Riffle: Reactive Relational State for Local-First Applications (UIST 2023)

2022 March

Merge what you can, fork what you can't: managing data integrity in local-first software (PaPoC '22)

2022 March

Building data-centric apps with a reactive relational database

resposta.role: Reactive relational state management for local-first applications and data integrity handling.

resposta.evidence: Project concluded; focuses on client-side state management with databases, unrelated to search, sync, or MCP servers for Markdown notes.
